description: Runs every weekday at 9:00 AM America/New_York to inspect failed checks since the last workspace-scoped watermark and write a typed handoff packet.
args: In ${repo_dir}, read the prior watermark at ${repo_dir}/.agents/scratch/triage_watermark.json if present, list open pull requests with failing checks via `gh pr list` and `gh pr checks`, skip items already recorded in the watermark, write a schema-valid handoff_packet.json to ${repo_dir}/.agents/scratch/handoff_packet.json, and update ${repo_dir}/.agents/scratch/triage_watermark.json atomically.

arguments.description: Local Git repository workspace to audit
